name: model-pin
description: Pin a project to one model, show a drift badge when the session leaves it, and re-apply the pin once.

lock.title: Ask before leaving the pin
lock.description: When on, a /model or picker switch away from the pinned model asks for confirmation first. Off by default: the badge and one re-apply are the whole behavior.

includeUserSettings.title: Pin to the user-level model too
includeUserSettings.description: When on, a "model" in ~/.claude/settings.json counts as a pin for projects that set none, so sessions started on another model are badged and switched back to it once. Off by default: a global default is not a per-project decision, and sessions started on a cheaper model on purpose stay there.
